rationale: The Latin anchors *ire*, *venire*, *gradi*, *procedere*, and *scandere* all point to physical movement/travel (going, coming, walking, proceeding, climbing), which aligns best with come.v.01 (move toward or approach something/somebody). The OE *a-stígan* carries a core sense of ascending/descending movement, and the "come" gloss here reflects literal locomotion rather than any abstract or resultative sense.
